# Order API — Design

## Problem
Create orders safely and leave an audit trail.

## Approach
Add one HTTP handler and an audit writer.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Duplicate idempotency keys return HTTP 409 without creating another order.
- [ ] Every created order writes one durable audit event.

## Out of scope
- Replacing authentication.
